name: Landau in der Pfalz (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided black over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Landau in der Pfalz (a black eagle on yellow within a red border).
history: Municipal flag of Landau in der Pfalz; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Landau arms — black eagle on yellow with red border
